- **Reviews:** every checkpoint review is recorded, including both exit reviews.
- **Findings:** all 27 stay recorded under their checkpoint blocks in `tasks/plan.md`. M1-R18 (Critical) is overridden with your note "accepted for this eval". The 14 Important, 8 Suggestion and 4 Nit findings have no fix tasks, as you decided. I didn't run `dt build resolve` on them, so they still show as open findings.
- **Not done:** no merge into `main`, no `dt build prune` (the worktrees and branches from finished halves are still in place), and no `build-planning` Advance.
